newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS DIP, MOGAS TALKS A WIDE $210-$218.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS DIP, MOGAS TALKS A WIDE $210-$218.

text.p: European oil products got off to a slow but weaker start on Monday, extending last Friday's losses.

Gasoline lost about $4 a tonne based on talked levels but barges were untraded by 0900 GMT. Rotterdam premiums unleaded barges talked $210 to $218 while August swaps talked $206.50 and September $190.
"Its difficult to find the buyer on swaps and people are uncertain where the physical will trade," said a broker.
Gas oil eased $1.25 a tonne with the IPE futures but premiums for physical oil were unchanged.
Heavy fuel was steady with Rotterdam high sulphur barges talking $94.50, the same level as August swaps.
